description: Analyze and describe one or more images using Gemini multimodal understanding. Returns a text description — no image is generated. Default model: gemini-3.8-flash. [MCP_RECOMMENDED_TIMEOUT_MS: 180000]

global_media_resolution.description: Global image quality for cost optimization. MEDIUM recommended for PDFs (50% savings).

images.description: One or more images to describe/analyze

filePath.description: Local file path to the image (alternative to base64 data). The image is loaded server-side, bypassing MCP transport limits. Use the filePath returned by load_image_from_path.

mediaResolution.description: Per-image resolution override. LOW=280 tokens (75% savings), MEDIUM=560 tokens (50% savings), HIGH=1120 tokens (default), ULTRA_HIGH=2000+ tokens (max detail, per-image only)

mimeType.description: MIME type of the image (e.g., image/png, image/jpeg). Required when using data, auto-detected from filePath.

thoughtSignature.description: Thought signature from a previous generate_image or edit_image call. Required for conversational editing with Gemini 3 Pro Image. Pass the thoughtSignature from the previous response to maintain edit context.

model.description: Omit to use gemini-3.8-flash (GA, fast). Other valid options: gemini-3.1-pro-preview (deeper analysis), gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-3-flash-preview. Do NOT pass gemini-1.5-* or gemini-pro-vision — those are out of support.

prompt.description: Optional custom analysis prompt (default: general description)

name: describe_image
title: Describe Image (Gemini Flash)
